heroHeadline: Parliament Lifts Immunity of PM Magyar and Two Orbán-Era Ministers as 'Operation Purge' Begins
heroSubtitle: On September 28 parliament stripped the immunity of PM Péter Magyar, at his own request over a theft probe, and of ex-ministers Balázs Hankó and Miklós Seszták, suspected of embezzlement and bribery. Hankó was detained that night. Fidesz boycotted the vote and Orbán denounced 'neo-communist tactics'.
footerNote: Tracker covers Hungary's political transition from Orbán's 2010 return to power through the 2026 post-election transition. Data reflects publicly available reports from verified sources.
